hooks.name: commit-guard
hooks.description: Before any agent shell command that runs git commit: block (exit 2) if .gitignore mentions kiro, LICENSE is missing, a real .env file or a secret (AWS, Google AIza, Groq gsk_, Context7, GitHub token, private key) is staged, or typecheck, lint or tests fail. Other shell commands pass straight through. Script: scripts/hooks/commit-guard.mjs.
